headline: Bose announces second-generation Ultra Open and Sport Open earbuds
summary: Three outlets report Bose announcing a second generation of its Ultra Open Earbuds alongside a new Sport Open model. One reports improved sound and battery life; another reports the products go on sale next month, a date the other texts do not give.
